display.purpose: Wordmark, labels, cartridge stock, and control legends.

label.purpose: Compact control, code, and keyboard labels.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables animation and transition; preserves static state feedback.

components.name: Quiet Utility Button
components.css: .ds-quiet-button { height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(44% 0.012 75); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: oklch(91% 0.02 85); font: 400 12px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-quiet-button:hover { background: oklch(30% 0.012 70); } .ds-quiet-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(85% 0.14 80); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-quiet-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Game Key
components.css: .ds-game-key { min-width: 34px; min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid oklch(48% 0.14 38); border-bottom: 3px solid oklch(48% 0.14 38); border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(74% 0.17 45), oklch(66% 0.18 42)); color: oklch(19% 0.015 50); box-shadow: 1px 2px 2px oklch(8% 0.01 70 / 0.55); font: 650 14px Obel Mono, monospace; } .ds-game-key:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-game-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(85% 0.14 80); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-game-key[aria-pressed="true"] { transform: translateY(2px); border-bottom-width: 1px; background: oklch(48% 0.14 38); color: oklch(91% 0.025 85); } .ds-game-key:disabled { opacity: .45; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Cartridge
components.description: Focusable, draggable game medium with a physical label.
components.css: .ds-cartridge { width: 128px; aspect-ratio: .85; padding: 14px 10px; border: 2px solid oklch(17% 0.008 70); border-bottom: 7px solid oklch(17% 0.008 70); border-radius: 7px 7px 5px 5px; background: linear-gradient(115deg, oklch(33% 0.008 80), oklch(22% 0.008 80)); color: oklch(25% 0.012 70); box-shadow: 0 6px 8px oklch(8% 0.01 70 / .55); cursor: grab; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), opacity 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-cartridge:hover { transform: translateY(-10px) rotate(0); } .ds-cartridge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(85% 0.14 80); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-cartridge[aria-pressed="true"] { opacity: .35; transform: translateY(5px); } .ds-cartridge-label { display: flex; height: 100%; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 8px; background: oklch(77% .07 165); font: 700 11px Obel Mono, monospace; text-align: left; } .ds-cartridge-label small { font-size: 6px; }

components.name: Cartridge Slot
components.description: Recessed insertion target with an explicit drop-ready state.
components.css: .ds-slot { width: 210px; height: 56px; border: 5px solid oklch(22% .008 80); border-radius: 8px; outline: 1px solid oklch(47% .012 80); background: oklch(17% .008 70); box-shadow: inset 0 5px 8px oklch(8% .01 70 / .55); color: oklch(80% .012 80); font: 400 12px Obel Mono, monospace; } .ds-slot:hover { color: oklch(90% .025 85); } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(85% .14 80); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-slot.ds-drop-ready { outline: 3px solid oklch(66% .18 42); outline-offset: 5px; color: oklch(74% .17 45); }

components.name: Primary Dialog Action
components.description: The high-contrast action used in the cream dialog surface.
components.css: .ds-dialog-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: oklch(25% .012 70); color: oklch(91% .025 85); font: 600 12px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-primary:hover { background: oklch(39% .015 70); } .ds-dialog-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(85% .14 80); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-dialog-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

narrative.overview: This is an Experience-mode recreation, not a dashboard: a warm dark room contains a black CRT, a cream-and-charcoal console, and a shelf of tangible cartridges. Texture comes from molded-plastic gradients, recessed wells, metal trim, scanlines, and deliberate physical depth—not decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Hardware leads; the television, console, and cartridge ritual are the interface.
Orange marks action, selection, and live status against cream, charcoal, and warm brown.
Labels are concise, mono, and printed onto the object they describe.

rules.name: The Material-First Rule
rules.body: Apply color as a material role—case, recess, label, key, metal, glass, screen—not as arbitrary panel decoration.

rules.name: The Printed-Label Rule
rules.body: Use Obel Mono for a label that appears to live on the physical object; do not use it to turn paragraphs into terminal text.

rules.name: The Recess-and-Lip Rule
rules.body: Use depth to explain how a part is built or pressed. Flat generic cards and floating dashboard panels do not belong here.

dos: Do retain the hierarchy of CRT, console, then shelf on every viewport.
Do make focus, pressed, selected, disabled, drag-ready, and reduced-motion states explicit.
Do use orange sparingly for action and live state, and preserve cream/charcoal material contrast.
donts: Don't replace the hardware scene with a hero, dashboard, card grid, or floating app chrome.
Don't flatten molded depth into uniform rounded rectangles or generic shadows.
Don't hide keyboard insertion, touch controls, or the non-microphone fallback on smaller devices.
